company.name: CAST AI
company.shortDescription: CAST AI is the leading Kubernetes automation platform that cuts AWS, Azure, and GCP customers’ cloud costs by over 50%
company.description:
CAST AI is the leading Kubernetes automation platform that cuts AWS, Azure, and GCP customers’ cloud costs by over 50%. 

CAST AI goes beyond monitoring clusters and making recommendations. The platform utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze and automatically optimize clusters in real time, reducing customers’ cloud costs, improving performance and security, and boosting DevOps and engineering productivity.

productsAndServices.description: A Kubernetes automation platform that continuously analyzes workload, infrastructure, cost, and performance signals to optimize cloud-native applications across public, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
productsAndServices.name: CAST AI Platform

productsAndServices.description: An automation platform for Kubernetes and cloud applications that uses workload, infrastructure, cost, and SLO signals to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency through automated actions and approved remediation runbooks.
productsAndServices.name: Application Performance Automation (APA) Platform

productsAndServices.description: A monitoring and analytics service that provides visibility into actual, requested, and provisioned Kubernetes usage and costs by cluster, namespace, workload, team, CPU, memory, and GPU.
productsAndServices.name: Kubernetes Cost and Performance Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: An automated workload rightsizing service that adjusts CPU, memory, requests, limits, and replica counts according to observed Kubernetes application behavior.
productsAndServices.name: Kubernetes Workload Optimization

productsAndServices.description: An infrastructure automation service that provisions and consolidates Kubernetes compute, selects suitable instance types, uses Spot capacity, and scales clusters according to workload demand.
productsAndServices.name: Kubernetes Infrastructure Automation

productsAndServices.description: A set of Kubernetes services for improving GPU utilization, scaling GPU workloads, sharing GPU capacity, and providing GPU cost visibility and cross-cloud access.
productsAndServices.name: GPU Optimization

aiResearchSummary.text: CAST AI is researching and developing systems for executing workloads across multiple cloud service providers, as described in 'Executing workloads across multiple cloud service providers.' The abstract details a multi-cloud service system that establishes tunnels and network overlays across various cloud providers, performing latency benchmarking to optimize workload execution. This work highlights CAST AI’s focus on multi-cloud workload management and network optimization.
